title: PLTR-DE: the troubleshooting playbook, step by step

steps.title: State the symptom precisely
steps.note: Stale output, one page of records, a row count drop, a slow build, failed access

steps.title: Find the first bad stage
steps.note: Walk lineage upstream before you change anything

steps.title: Classify the cause
steps.note: Data, code, permissions, resources or upstream

steps.title: Assess the blast radius
steps.note: How far the problem reaches, before any repair

steps.title: Smallest safe repair, then verify
steps.note: Not a full rebuild, blind memory or broad access

steps.title: Add a control
steps.note: So the same failure does not happen again

before: Rule 4: expectations block, health checks alert
caption: Work through the steps in order; on a question that asks what to do first, the answer is usually an early, evidence-gathering step.
alt: Six steps: state the symptom, find the first bad stage, classify the cause, assess the blast radius, repair and verify, add a control.
